label: Cross-session synthesis: session 2 validation of the +17.5 pp premium (commit b82df27) changes what my representation dead-channel finding implies. Static reasoning over two committed findings, nothing re-run.

what_session2_established.population_gap: 32B-I RICH 0.3953 against RECENT 0.3834, a +1.18 pp gap with CI [-0.0152, +0.0389], which DOES NOT EXCLUDE ZERO.
what_session2_established.where_17_5_lives: conditional on the 11.5 percent of questions where the RECENT window MISSES the evidence (+17.53 pp, CI excludes 0). On the 88.5 percent it covers, full history is worth -0.94 pp, not significant.

correction_to_my_earlier_framing.what_I_said: porting SimpleStream today would make it "earn a timeliness score its design never produced".
correction_to_my_earlier_framing.why_that_was_backwards: with representation ignored, _submit_recall sends and charges the FULL believed history, so SimpleStream today pays full-history cost and full-history latency and receives full-history accuracy. It does not gain an unearned timeliness win; it LOSES the cost and timeliness advantage that is its entire point.
correction_to_my_earlier_framing.corrected: porting SimpleStream today UNDERSTATES it. It would be scored as always-CLOUD on both axes. Deferring it remains right, but the reason is that the port would penalise the arm, not flatter it.

restated_stakes_of_the_dead_channel.on_accuracy: SMALL. A RECENT-choosing arm forgoes, at population level, 1.18 pp that StudyR1 cannot distinguish from zero. The accuracy distortion from the dead channel is within noise on this workload, which session 2 separately characterises as history-insensitive.
restated_stakes_of_the_dead_channel.on_cost: LARGE AND CERTAIN. On the reported Part A measurement a RECENT request sends and is charged 467 tokens against a full history of 5,431 to 14,881, roughly a 12x to 32x reduction, with the budget moving 202.795 to 192.781 GPU-s.
restated_stakes_of_the_dead_channel.conclusion: the representation dead channel is primarily a COST-measurement fault, not an accuracy-measurement fault. That is the opposite emphasis from the one the +17.5 pp framing invited, and it REINFORCES rather than weakens the case for Part A, because the cost half is the half that is large and certain.

consequence_for_scoring_my_ports.population_average_column: would separate almost nothing for an evidence-selection arm and would sit below its own noise floor, so it must not be used to rank StreamScout, CoVStream, SimpleStream or QueryStream QDP.
consequence_for_scoring_my_ports.required_form: stratified by whether the RECENT window covers the evidence, since that is the only split on which the effect exists.
consequence_for_scoring_my_ports.interaction_with_my_guard: published_scoring_inputs.py checks that a consumed field holds real values. It cannot check that a column has the statistical power to separate arms. These are two different failures and both need checking before a ranked table is written.

_provenance.script: static synthesis of committed findings b82df27 and partB_precheck.json; nothing run
